notes.title: The one where we increased the version to 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello there!



I hope you are having a fantastic week! Once again, thank you for your support, feedback and positive reviews.

Today we are bringing you version 1.1 - introducing the custom game mode for the single player.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45163366/af1f910f0c83daac2c7b37fe444ba19b7abaa527.png"]

It's a pretty straightforward feature that lets you choose which assets will be available during the initial draft or, if you feel like it, you can assign assets directly to a player.



One quirk to be aware of is the First Player toggle ("1."). Its behaviour shifts based on whether you've manually assigned assets to a player. If no assets are assigned, the toggle determines who picks first in the draft. But if you’ve given any assets to a player—even just one—it instead decides who takes the first turn after the draft.



Another neat touch: we haven’t restricted duplicates. So yes, if you’re in the mood, you can stage full-on mirror matches.



Before I bid you farewell, here's a quick list of fixes also present in this build:

+ fixed a bug where the UI mistakenly considered Franz DeLasse as triggered in situations where he wasn't, thus showing the wrong energy value ( According to the rulebook, Franz DeLasse's ability is only active during "production actions" and not energy produced by other means, like tech tiles )

+ fixed a bug where Mahiri wouldn't work if Elon Audia was a possible target

+ fixed a bug where the objective tooltip could remain stuck open, even persisting in the main menu in some cases

+ fixed a crash occurring in the main menu when clicking the "Go Offline" button in case of a network error



As always, have a great dam rest of the week!



Cheers,

Cody

notes.title: Barrage release date announced
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45163366/f791c4bb1aa54d7e1715e131c1b97c5a776cfb06.png

Howdy folks,

The wait is almost over! We're thrilled to announce that Barrage, our highly anticipated strategy game, will be launching on May 15! 💥

Get ready to dive into a world of intense tactical gameplay, where every move counts and your decisions will shape the future of the French Alps.

Mark your calendars and stay tuned for more updates. We can't wait to share this adventure with you!

Until next time,
Amintiri
